comment: Audit advisories with NO patched release available — the gate cannot go green on them until upstream ships a fix. Each entry needs a reason and a review date; prune on every dependency pass. Adding an entry that HAS a patched version available is a gate violation.

exceptions.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS in template compilation; advisory lists NO patched version (<0.0.0) — every published release is vulnerable. Dev-time transitive via bundlers; not reachable in shipped site runtime. Revisit when a patched braces ships.
